visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male hand holds a small green Yoshi keychain with orange shoes, rotating it to show all sides. The background features a black mechanical keyboard on a wooden desk and a colorful anime-themed desk mat. Below the keychain are two JoJo's Bizarre Adventure wafer packs. (2) The hand sets down the keychain and picks up a blue JoJo's Bizarre Adventure wafer pack, displaying the character art of Jotaro and Polnareff. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the metallic texture of the foil packaging. (3) The person uses both hands to tear open the blue foil pack from the top. They pull out a white plastic tray containing a rectangular wafer cookie and a collectible card sealed in a small plastic sleeve. (4) The hand holds up the newly revealed card, which shows the character Alessi from the JoJo series against a purple striped background. The person turns the card around to show the back, which contains character stats and Japanese text. (5) The hand reaches for a second yellow foil pack featuring the character DIO. They proceed to tear this pack open as well, revealing another wafer and a card. This card features DIO in a dynamic pose. (6) Both cards are placed side-by-side on the anime desk mat, which depicts a character with long purple hair. The person gestures towards the cards, showing the successful pulls from the unboxing session.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking excitedly in Mandarin Chinese. An upbeat pop background music track with electronic synthesizers and a steady four-on-the-floor beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp crinkling sound of foil packaging being handled occurs, signaling the start of the unboxing. The speaker's pitch rises as he anticipates the pull. (3) The rhythmic tearing of foil (plastic rustle) is heard clearly as the first pack is opened. The speaker makes a surprised sound followed by a brief pause in speech while the music continues. (4) A metallic click or snap sound is heard when the card is pulled from its sleeve. The speaker identifies the character 'Alessi' with a slightly puzzled but humorous tone. (5) A second series of foil tearing noises occurs as the yellow pack is opened. The speaker's arousal increases, and his volume peaks as he reveals the character 'DIO'. (6) The video ends with a celebratory tone in the speaker's voice, accompanied by the tapping of cards on a table surface and the fade-out of the upbeat BGM.
